module.purpose: Defines the rendering, geometry, resizing, interpolation, and SVG export behavior for freehand draw shapes in tldraw.
module.summary: This module implements the shape utility and SVG renderer for freehand drawing paths. It converts encoded draw segments into geometry, selects dot, polygon, or polyline representations, renders solid and patterned fills, applies zoom-sensitive stroke behavior, exports SVG definitions, and supplies resize and interpolation logic. It also exposes display configuration and default properties for the draw shape.
module.businessContext: Supports the collaborative whiteboard drawing tool and its exported artwork. Failures affect freehand stroke rendering, selection behavior, resizing, and SVG export.

detail.summary: DrawShapeUtil defines the public shape utility contract for TLDrawShape instances, including their registered type metadata, display options, geometry, rendering, export, resize, and interpolation hooks.

units.name: getGeometry

detail.name: getGeometry
preconditions: shape is a TLDrawShape with segments, scaleX, scaleY, scale, isPen, isClosed, and fill properties.
postconditions: Returns a geometry object derived from the shape's scaled points and effective stroke width.
A single sufficiently small segment is represented by a filled circle centered at (-sw, -sw) with radius sw.
A closed stroke with more than two stroke points is represented by a polygon whose fill state is true unless shape.props.fill is 'none'.
A non-closed stroke with one stroke point is represented by a filled circle centered at (-sw, -sw) with radius sw.
All other strokes are represented by a polyline.
invariants: The effective stroke width is (display stroke width + 1) multiplied by shape.props.scale.
Point extraction uses shape.props.segments, shape.props.scaleX, and shape.props.scaleY.
Closed-stroke polygon selection requires shape.props.isClosed and more than two stroke points.
edgeCases: When there is exactly one segment and its bounding box is narrower than 2*sw and shorter than 2*sw, returns a filled Circle2d without stroke-point processing.
When a closed stroke produces more than two stroke points, returns a Polygon2d and marks it filled unless the fill value is 'none'.
When stroke processing produces exactly one point and the stroke was not returned as a closed polygon, returns a filled Circle2d.
When the stroke is not a qualifying dot or closed polygon, returns a Polyline2d.
detail.summary: Computes the geometric representation of a draw shape from its scaled segments and display stroke width. It represents sufficiently small strokes as filled circles, closed strokes as polygons, and other strokes as polylines.

specLiterals.role: Determines whether a closed draw stroke polygon is filled.
Added to the display stroke width before scaling and used in the single-segment dot threshold.
Scales the effective stroke width for the single-segment dot bounding-box threshold.

specTests.then: The result is a filled Circle2d with x = -sw, y = -sw, and radius = sw.
The result is a Polygon2d using those stroke points, filled when shape.props.fill is not 'none'.
The result is a Polyline2d constructed from the generated stroke points.

units.name: getIndicatorPath

detail.name: getIndicatorPath
preconditions: shape is a valid TLDrawShape with props.segments, props.scaleX, props.scaleY, scale, isPen, dash, and isComplete available.
The owning util has an editor that can provide an efficient zoom level.
postconditions: Returns a Path2D representing the draw shape's indicator geometry.
The stroke geometry is derived from the shape's segments and freehand rendering options.
At zoom levels that satisfy the force-solid condition, the indicator is generated using solid rendering behavior.
invariants: Stroke width is based on the display stroke width plus 1, multiplied by shape.props.scale.
The complete-state option is true when shape.props.isComplete is true or the last segment has type 'straight'.
The single-point draw-dash variation is applied only when the shape is not a pen, the dash value is 'draw', the zoom is not forced solid, and exactly one point is present.
edgeCases: A shape whose segments resolve to exactly one point may receive a deterministic-seed-based stroke-width variation when it uses the 'draw' dash style and is not a pen.
A shape with no segments or insufficient stroke points is passed through the stroke-generation path's handling for that point count.
When zoomLevel is below 0.5 and also below 1.5 divided by the computed stroke width, forceSolid is enabled.
When the last segment is of type 'straight', the stroke is treated as complete even if shape.props.isComplete is false.
detail.summary: Builds and returns the rendered indicator path for a draw shape. The path reflects the shape's scaled segments, display stroke width, zoom level, pen and dash settings, and completion state.

specLiterals.role: Dash style that enables single-point stroke-width variation for non-pen shapes.
Segment type that causes the stroke to be treated as complete.
Zoom threshold used by the force-solid rendering condition.
Numerator in the stroke-width-relative force-solid zoom threshold.
Stroke-width adjustment added to the display stroke width.
Divisor controlling the maximum random single-point stroke-width variation.

specTests.when: getIndicatorPath is called while the zoom level does not satisfy the force-solid condition.
specTests.then: The stroke width used to build the indicator includes a seeded random variation of up to one sixth of the computed base stroke width.
The freehand stroke options treat the shape as complete.
The forceSolid condition is true and the indicator-generation logic uses solid-rendering behavior.

units.name: toSvg

detail.name: toSvg
preconditions: shape is a valid TLDrawShape with props.fill and a non-zero props.scale.
ctx provides a colorMode and an addExportDef function.
postconditions: The fill export definition for shape.props.fill is registered through ctx.addExportDef.
Returns an SVG group whose transform is scale(1 / shape.props.scale).
The group contains DrawShapeSvg configured with the shape, zoomOverride 1, and the computed stroke and fill display values.
invariants: The SVG scale factor is the reciprocal of shape.props.scale.
The rendered SVG uses display values computed for the export context's color mode.
edgeCases: A non-default shape scale produces a reciprocal scale transform on the returned SVG group.
Any fill value is passed to getFillDefForExport before rendering.
The export color mode controls the strokeColor, strokeWidth, and fillColor supplied to DrawShapeSvg.
stateMutations: ctx is mutated by registering the fill export definition through ctx.addExportDef.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an SVG/JSX <g> element with transform="scale(${1 / shape.props.scale})" containing DrawShapeSvg with shape, zoomOverride, strokeColor, strokeWidth, and fillColor props.
detail.summary: Converts a draw shape into an SVG group for export. The group uses the inverse shape scale and renders the shape with display values derived from the export context's color mode.

specLiterals.role: SVG group transform format used to apply the inverse shape scale.
Sets DrawShapeSvg's zoomOverride and forms the numerator of the inverse scale factor.

specTests.when: toSvg is called with the shape and context.
specTests.then: The context receives the fill definition for the shape's fill, and the returned SVG group has transform="scale(0.5)" with DrawShapeSvg configured with zoomOverride 1 and the computed display values.

units.name: onResize

detail.name: onResize
preconditions: shape.props.scaleX and shape.props.scaleY are numeric values.
info.scaleX and info.scaleY are numeric resize factors.
postconditions: When both resulting scales are nonzero, returns a props update containing the multiplied scaleX and scaleY values.
When either resulting scale is zero, returns undefined.
invariants: The resulting horizontal scale equals info.scaleX multiplied by shape.props.scaleX.
The resulting vertical scale equals info.scaleY multiplied by shape.props.scaleY.
The input shape and resize information are not directly mutated.
edgeCases: If the computed horizontal scale is zero, returns undefined without producing an update.
If the computed vertical scale is zero, returns undefined without producing an update.
Negative or fractional nonzero scale results are returned as computed.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns undefined, or an object with a props field containing scaleX and scaleY numeric updates.
detail.summary: Computes updated draw-shape scale properties from the resize factors and the shape's current scales. If either resulting scale is zero, it performs no resize and returns no update.

specLiterals.role: A computed scale equal to zero causes the resize update to be omitted.

specTests.when: onResize is called with the shape and resize information.
specTests.then: The result contains props.scaleX = 1 and props.scaleY = 6.

detail.name: DrawShapeSvg
detail.signature: function DrawShapeSvg({ shape, zoomOverride, strokeColor, strokeWidth: baseStrokeWidth, fillColor, patternFillFallbackColor, }: { shape: TLDrawShape; zoomOverride?: number; strokeColor: string; strokeWidth: number; fillColor: string; patternFillFallbackColor: string })
preconditions: shape conforms to TLDrawShape and provides valid draw-shape properties and segments.
strokeColor, fillColor, and patternFillFallbackColor are CSS-compatible color strings.
postconditions: Returns a JSX SVG fragment representing the draw shape.
Uses the supplied zoomOverride when present; otherwise obtains the efficient zoom level from the editor.
Applies the shape scale to the base stroke width and to pattern rendering.
invariants: A draw shape with one rendered point is rendered using dot geometry rather than a stroked multi-point path.
Closed shapes with a non-none fill render a fill path when enough points exist.
The draw dash style uses freehand ink rendering unless forceSolid is active.
Dash rendering is omitted when shape.props.dash is 'none'.
Pattern fills use PatternFill and receive the computed path, fill colors, and shape scale.
edgeCases: When zoom is below 0.5 and also below 1.5 / strokeWidth, forceSolid is enabled and the draw dash is rendered through the solid-stroke path branch.
When zoom is below 0.2, dotAdjustment is 9; otherwise it is 0.1.

When the shape is a non-pen draw-dashed shape with exactly one point and forceSolid is false, the stroke width receives a deterministic shape-id-seeded random increase of up to one sixth of the current width.
When a draw-dashed shape has a closed patterned fill and more than one point, it renders PatternFill followed by the freehand ink path.
When a shape has fewer than two stroke points, it uses dot geometry and uses the stroke color as the dot fill.
When a shape is open, its fill is treated as 'none'.
When a closed shape has fill 'none', no fill element is rendered.
When shape.props.dash is 'none', the stroke path is not rendered.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a React JSX fragment containing SVG path elements and, for pattern fills, PatternFill components. Stroke paths use round line caps; solid strokes use the computed stroke width, dash array, and a dash offset of "0".
detail.summary: Renders a draw shape as SVG using its scaled segments, stroke, fill, dash, closure, and zoom-dependent rendering options. It supports freehand, solid, patterned, dotted, and single-point draw-shape rendering.

specLiterals.role: A final straight segment causes the shape to be treated as complete.
Selects freehand draw-dash rendering and its single-point width variation.
Selects PatternFill rendering for filled shapes.
Disables fill or stroke rendering according to the relevant shape property.
Zoom threshold used when deciding whether to force solid rendering.
Zoom-to-stroke-width threshold factor used when deciding whether to force solid rendering.
Zoom threshold selecting the large dot adjustment.
Dot adjustment used at very low zoom.
Default dot adjustment used above the very-low-zoom threshold.
SVG strokeDashoffset value for solid-branch stroke paths.
SVG strokeLinecap value for rendered stroke paths.

specTests.then: The returned SVG contains no stroke path for the shape, while a qualifying fill may still be rendered.
The output includes a PatternFill using the freehand stroke outline and also includes the freehand ink path.

specTests.when: DrawShapeSvg renders it through the solid-stroke branch.
specTests.then: The shape uses dot geometry, fills the dot with strokeColor, and does not use a multi-point dash array.
